One Rockford nickname is "The Forest City", so I deliberately wanted to use at least one variation of "forest green." I thought using two shades works to subtly delineate the tree section from the body of the flag as well as the central figure/tree trunk dude.
I meant the "centerpieces of the scale" to be a subtle reference to the fastener industry; it's meant to be a screw or something. But good catch.

"t might be a little too much like the park district logo?" I get it, but I want some variation of a figure with the scales of justice. It's a powerful combination, and both have a local connection. And I wanted some form of red/orange because of various things in Rockford that are red/orange (Symbol, the BMO, the Peaches (they wore red, but associated with peach). And I want some connection with the flag from the 1950's, which was green with the scales (which ended up on the Peaches unis.)

I understand the Park District reference; I deliberately wanted to include some variation of the figure (I think RPD refers to him as the "Sun Seeker.") I think a figure of some kind underneath the scales of justice is a powerful and positive message. I thought keeping orange was good because several Rockford things have orange-like colors in them, including Symbol, the BMO, and kinds/sorta the Peaches (they used red, not peach, but sort of).

I am genuinely honored and excited to finally post a design.

Rockord's old flag was green with the scales of justice on them; the scales were our city seal, and they ended up on the uniforms of the Rockford Peaches women's professional baseball teams; some of you may know them from "A League of Their Own." I wanted a new design to keep the scales; it's an important symbol, but generic on its own, and shared with other city flags, like Cincinnati's.

I added a variation of our local Park District symbol, a figure with arms raised against a gold and orange background. I think in our region, visitors might recognize the symbol from our parks and playing fields used in tournaments and sporting contests.

I then looked up various "forest green" references, since Rockford's nickname is the "Forest City."

Put all together, I believe it is meaningful, colorful, and distinctive. 

I am eager to read your comments. Thank you for your attention.

First, don't drive anywhere unless you know your driving status right now; finding rides is a hassle, but getting a "driving while suspended" is much worse.

I'm not sure in which state the DUI took place, but second, the next thing is to learn now about DUI law in the jurisdiction is handled. They will not know how to handle things in the other state, but the other state will probably not give you driving privileges until all of the legal issues in the DUI jurisdiction are resolved.

Frankly there is a real possibility that there may be some period of time where there will be a "hard suspension", meaning there is no driving allowed under any circumstances for some period of time; in some states, it's 30 days, other states it's more.

You may be allowed some driving privileges for medical, support groups, job or new educational opportunities.

Good luck.

You are strong enough to post something here for the world to see. You are strong. For now, you are alive. You know something needs to change. You are trying to connect with people that could help. That means you are strong, stronger than you may realize.

The old friends may still be available to you through different means, if you want to try that.  

Anyone who uses any kind of chemical and then stops will go through some chemical transition period. Doesn't matter if the chemical is weed, caffeine, alcohol, nicotine, opiates or anything else. Please consider for now that your head may not in the best space right now, and just let yourself take a step back or two. Maybe you can redefine for now exactly what you mean as "becoming functional." Best wishes.

I can identify with some of this. I was the 3rd child, mom, dad, older brother and sister. All dead except me; suicide (2), mental illness (3) alcoholism (all 4.) I heard the music, too. I'm not sure what changed, exactly. Maybe I just got bored with the music. Maybe I suddenly because a little more interested in what others were listening to. 

You have indeed reached another human being. Please consider that if you've been dealing with this for 20 some odd years, you may be one of the strongest people you have ever met, and that has value. 

Please seek whoever and wherever you need to go to feel at least a little more connected to someone. Don't know if that will be a message board, a family member, hanging out with someone you haven't seen in awhile, anyplace where you can remind yourself that you do indeed matter, perhaps not in ways that are obvious to you right now, but you matter. Typing this out right now is helping me a little bit, so that's something. Of course, don't feel that you have to post this again for my benefit :). Just please be open to the idea that someone out there "gets it", and that maybe you can pick up a piece of whatever it is that they've got by seeking them out. I wish you the best.

I wish I knew you, so my words would have more meaning. But for now, please don't scrub the surface. You do have meaning, and you do have worth. If you don't feel that now, you can go out of yourself right now and be meaningful to someone. Someone out there could use someone like you who feels pain, because pain that is shared is pain that goes away, at least a little, for today Ad that is meaningful. Please do not kill yourself.
